problem_text:
A municipality aims to devise a strategy for curbing nutrient runoff from several agricultural fields into a nearby watershed. Initially, no mitigation practices are in place.

The characteristics of each field are as follows:
* For Field 1, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.421, and the cultivated area is 242.158.
* For Field 2, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.781, and the cultivated area is 161.565.
* For Field 3, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 1.914, and the cultivated area is 206.613.
* For Field 4, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.149, and the cultivated area is 79.388.
* For Field 5, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 0.875, and the cultivated area is 82.893.
* For Field 6, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.672, and the cultivated area is 100.713.
* For Field 7, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 0.947, and the cultivated area is 205.64.
* For Field 8, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.28, and the cultivated area is 113.278.
* For Field 9, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 1.549, and the cultivated area is 164.661.
* For Field 10, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 1.274, and the cultivated area is 263.853.

To reduce nutrient loss, several best management practices (BMPs) are available, each with a specific effectiveness:
* Practice 1 reduces nutrient loss by 46%
* Practice 2 reduces nutrient loss by 90%
* Practice 3 reduces nutrient loss by 19%
* Practice 4 reduces nutrient loss by 71%
* Practice 5 reduces nutrient loss by 43%
* Practice 6 reduces nutrient loss by 52%
* Practice 7 reduces nutrient loss by 57%
* Practice 8 reduces nutrient loss by 84%
* Practice 9 reduces nutrient loss by 42%
* Practice 10 reduces nutrient loss by 70%

Implementing a practice on a field incurs an additional cost per unit of cultivated area. The cost matrix for all field–practice combinations is provided below:

| Field \ Practice | Practice1 | Practice2 | Practice3 | Practice4 | Practice5 | Practice6 | Practice7 | Practice8 | Practice9 | Practice10 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Field 1 | 113.995 | 127.756 | 115.934 | 166.798 | 19.295 | 38.169 | 134.123 | 16.977 | 172.228 | 136.729 |
| Field 2 | 169.223 | 66.704 | 184.873 | 19.316 | 89.222 | 43.867 | 137.697 | 126.107 | 141.388 | 123.044 |
| Field 3 | 159.588 | 43.71 | 96.514 | 120.004 | 186.981 | 27.694 | 66.866 | 80.028 | 81.998 | 22.857 |
| Field 4 | 91.192 | 114.59 | 65.638 | 35.564 | 141.978 | 62.14 | 110.14 | 109.683 | 142.208 | 126.29 |
| Field 5 | 30.767 | 148.648 | 129.506 | 197.566 | 101.896 | 140.844 | 187.439 | 197.393 | 64.566 | 125.68 |
| Field 6 | 70.133 | 109.824 | 199.055 | 77.232 | 34.645 | 116.901 | 108.744 | 130.053 | 103.576 | 44.182 |
| Field 7 | 125.787 | 144.632 | 196.059 | 10.3 | 14.557 | 128.838 | 32.406 | 171.133 | 161.917 | 199.808 |
| Field 8 | 88.668 | 73.421 | 116.479 | 131.126 | 12.146 | 48.226 | 63.509 | 160.137 | 68.477 | 106.271 |
| Field 9 | 71.546 | 11.165 | 140.309 | 74.859 | 147.635 | 127.039 | 15.532 | 43.37 | 72.798 | 74.208 |
| Field 10 | 137.77 | 184.071 | 161.478 | 132.674 | 101.484 | 129.168 | 179.491 | 112.024 | 73.671 | 158.958 |

The decision involves selecting which practices to apply to each field (fields may adopt multiple practices concurrently), and a field may also remain partially untreated if required. The objective is to guarantee that the total nutrient load is diminished by at least a proportion P = 0.407 of the initial load, while minimizing the aggregate implementation cost.
